def factor_drawdown_stress_ratio(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy['close']
    # running maximum close
    running_max = close.cummax()
    drawdown = (running_max - close) / running_max
    # rolling sum of drawdown over 60 days
    drawdown_sum = drawdown.rolling(60, min_periods=60).sum()
    # trailing volatility of returns (60-day)
    returns = close.pct_change()
    vol = returns.rolling(60, min_periods=60).std(ddof=1)
    # ratio of drawdown sum to vol (both non-negative)
    factor = drawdown_sum / vol.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    factor = factor.fillna(0.0)
    factor.name = "factor_drawdown_stress_ratio"
    return factor
